spoken: Statistico brings regression estimates, uncertainty, prediction and diagnostics into one interactive workspace. Explore how the fitted relationship behaves, examine alternative scenarios, and investigate observations that may shape your conclusions.
How does the fitted relationship change with the predictor? Choose another predictor and watch the effect plot respond.
R-squared summarizes how much of the variation in Sales this model explains in this dataset.
Remove Store Size and Statistico refits the model, updating the coefficients and equation.
With the full model restored, let's explore a sales scenario.
As we increase ad spend, the model updates its sales forecast. Store size and region stay fixed.
How sensitive is the fit to these observations?
Exclude the flagged rows and compare the fit. Read the change as a sensitivity check, not as proof of a better model.
These demonstrations are part of a broader regression toolkit.
See the fit. Read the uncertainty.
